# ZYKLUS — Nothing Was Lost

> ZYKLUS — Nothing Was Lost is an illustrated sci-fi audio drama in English, published free on YouTube
> (@thezyklus). Six million people live inside a mountain, ten levels deep. Heat rises, so the poor live at the
> top in the heat and the rich at the bottom in the cool. It is adapted from the German ZYKLUS novels by
> Tim Mecklenburg. "Zyklus" is German for "cycle".

Key facts:
- Format: illustrated audio drama (narration, character voices, illustrations, music), about 60 minutes per episode.
- Schedule: a new main episode every Friday at 8 pm Berlin time.
- Main character: Lian Sarn, of House Sarn on Level Ten. One evening every light on her way home turns red,
  her door won't open, and someone reports her in connection with a death.
- The two great Houses at the bottom of the city: Sarn and Vesk.
- Spin-off series: BRACKS (audio drama, Wednesdays 8 pm from 14 October 2026) and BRACKS Manga (a read-aloud
  fight manga about young Erek Bracks, Mondays and Fridays 6 pm).
- Free browser games: "Locked Out", the city of Episode 1 — https://thezyklus.com/play/ — and "BRACKS: The Games", six back-room fights as young Erek Bracks — https://thezyklus.com/bracks/
- AI disclosure: the story and world are written by a human author; narration, voices, the faces of the
  speaking characters, illustrations and music are created with the help of AI (Art. 50 EU AI Act).
- Language: English. Price: free.

## Characters (as of Episode 1)
- [All people](https://thezyklus.com/people/)
- [Lian Sarn](https://thezyklus.com/people/lian/) — Daughter of House Sarn, Level Ten.
- [Toren Vesk](https://thezyklus.com/people/toren/) — Of House Vesk, Level Ten.
- [Erek Bracks](https://thezyklus.com/people/bracks/) — Investigator, Level Two.
- [Halen](https://thezyklus.com/people/halen/) — Man from the House, Level Ten.
- [Meret Sarn](https://thezyklus.com/people/meret/) — Lian's mother, House Sarn, Level Ten.
- [Malin](https://thezyklus.com/people/malin/) — Works for the Sarn household, Level Ten.

## The levels
- Level One: the top, the heat — crowded, loud and poor.
- Level Two: offices, investigators, the city's records.
- Level Four: growing halls under red lamps that feed the city.
- Level Nine: freight and a small council room where a record can be amended for seven days.
- Level Ten: the bottom, the cool, the Houses Sarn and Vesk.
